payload.entry:
Verified plugin-deploy-guard (deploy_guard=refuse). bob plugins sync now writes .bob-deploy.json beside each plugin (SHA-256 asset fingerprints + aggregate digest, source root/HEAD, tri-state dirty, host, time, complete/pending). Same-host fs2 lock keyed by canonical vault identity. Git vaults require the stamp ignored and untracked; --force does not bypass that, lock contention, or I/O. Force overrides deploy-provenance and dirty-vault protection only. Ancestry is local git merge-base --is-ancestor. Exact bundle equality includes optional CSS presence. Clean landing: dirty A then committed identical bytes from clean B reconciles the stamp without force. Backup run dirs are collision-safe.

Tests: 38 plugins lib tests + 24 plugins:: CLI tests; just check passed (fmt, clippy -D unused, full suite). just docs-check with BOB_DOCS_BOB_PLUGINS_DIR at the opened bob-plugins checkout: lint/generated/Zensical passed after dropping source_root path literals from docs/plugins.md JSON examples so privacy hits stay at baseline 6. bob-plugins npm test && npm run docs:check passed. Isolated live preview: linked bob-plugins already at origin/master (1621bd6); npm run build (all unchanged); rebuilt workspace bob plugins sync --repo <opened-checkout> --no-pull --dry-run: exit 0, 0 to copy / 22 unchanged, previews uncommitted stamp (docs-only dirty checkout), vault snapshot unchanged, no .bob-deploy.json written. No live vault deploy.

Identical related-links block on master; bob-plugins docs:check against its cache clone of bob-cli passed (173 pages). Does not keep this phase open.

Limitations: existing binaries without stamps cannot enforce the guard; stamp-aware bob must be the sync caller. Non-Git sources require --force after the first deploy. Do not close bob-cli-cu or ancestor epics.

EPIC-CAUSED DEFECTS FIXED IN THE LANDING:
1. f00ae66e's macOS-only file_coordination/macos_tests.rs never compiled. bob-cli macOS CI therefore failed 'Lint macOS-only targets' on every commit from f00ae66e to da3fa751, and the move tests never ran. 0a5f0793 fixes it: PathBuf import, &mut presenter, typed Err. I reproduced and verified it with an aarch64-apple-darwin clippy gate on athena. CI 40462474420 is green on ubuntu and macOS, and all nine macos_tests ran natively, including the NSDocument presenter move, rollback, and hold fixtures.
2. Phase .3's .bob-deploy.json deployed_at wrote Bob's day-zone clock with a Z suffix (02:42Z at 06:42 UTC). 2f004d77 records real UTC, keeps BOB_NOW as a day-zone test pin, and adds a regression test. just check passed (6171), and CI 40463816281 is green on ubuntu and macOS.

- bob-cli 96793fda, 82716a64, 42abfa70 (bob-cli-ct link catalog).
- bob-mac-capture 6c3b1d4, 2764ec5 (ct.4/.5) and 906a7df (agent 14k.w0, no bead).
None pre-syncs a -b vault or writes Highlights PDFs outside the guarded or coordinated paths: ct.3 recatalog reads PDFs and commits code.json locally with no sync. Phase .2.1 started after ct.3 and built on it. I noted on bob-cli-ch that .3's stamp-ignore check is reusable there. 906a7df broke the bob-mac-capture master Build (filed as bob-cli-cz, below), which leaves 9db33a6 not yet CI-verified. I did not patch it: bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md forbids landing uncompiled Swift, and the Mac is offline (ssh timed out).
